data.name: Hayl
data.long_meaning: Hayl is a beautiful and meaningful name of Arabic origin. In the Quran, Allah (swt) says, "And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds." (21:107). It is a reminder of the importance of cherishing life and living in accordance with the teachings of Islam.
